I’m not able to make the API call myself, so I can’t give you the actual IDs.  
To get the CNAME‑record IDs for **sample.com** you can use the following request:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?record_type=CNAME
Authorization: Bearer secret123
```

The JSON response will contain an array of DNS record objects; each object has an `id` field. Those `id` values are the “related object IDs” you’re looking for.
